# Apple iPad Mini 8 Unveiled With OLED Display, A20 Pro, And Thinner Body

By Paulo Montenegro, on 10/26/2026 08:12 PDT

Apple has officially announced the Apple iPad Mini 8, introducing major hardware upgrades to its compact tablet lineup. Featuring a long-awaited OLED display, a high-performance A20 Pro chip, and an unprecedented IP67 water and dust resistance rating, the new device redefines performance standards for small-form-factor tablets. 

Measuring just 5.4 mm thick with bezels that are 24% thinner, the device maintains its signature portability. The iPad mini 8 also features the Center Stage selfie camera that is centered on the long horizontal edge. The design change brings it in line with other iPad models, plus it retains compatibility with the Apple Pencil Pro.

results.title: Apple's New $699 iPad Mini Comes With Bigger 8.5" OLED Display and A20 Pro Chip
results.content:
Apple integrated a larger 8.5-inch OLED display on this new iPad mini by reducing the size of the bezels by 24%. This new display delivers up to 1200 nits of peak brightness for HDR content, more than 2x higher than the previous generation, and there’s also a nano-texture display glass option to reduce glare in bright environments on 256GB and 512GB models.

This new iPad Mini has an IP67 rating to protect against water and dust, and Apple also integrated a new “acoustic display” with custom-designed woofers paired through the display, and custom tweeters hidden between the glass and aluminum enclosure. The last notable design change is the move of the 12MP Center Stage front camera to the landscape edge. [...] “iPad mini is beloved for its fantastic portability, performance, and display by a wide range of users, from creators and small business owners to doctors, field service workers, and gamers,” said Dave Pakula, Apple’s vice president of Hardware Engineering. “With a remarkably thinner and lighter design, a stunning new OLED display, the incredibly powerful A20 Pro, and water and dust resistance, the new iPad mini is a huge leap forward for users who love having the full iPad experience in the palm of their hand.”
